documentation_excerpts.text: Write a structured specification before writing any code. The spec is the shared source of truth between you and the human engineer — it defines what we're building, why, and how we'll know it's done. Code without a spec is guessing.

- Starting a new project or feature - Requirements are ambiguous or incomplete - The change touches multiple files or modules - You're about to make an architectural decision - The task would take more than 30 minutes to implement
**When NOT to use:** Single-line fixes, typo corrections, or changes where requirements are unambiguous and self-contained.
